comment: No `paths` override: this project used to remap the `@zmdb/*` imports to
`../*/dist/*.d.ts`, i.e. to build artifacts that are gitignored (unresolvable
in a fresh CI checkout) and stale whenever a sibling source changed without a
rebuild. The source-based paths in tsconfig.json are the single source of
truth. No `rootDir`/`outDir` either: this project is `noEmit`, and a rootDir
of `src` makes every cross-package import a TS6059. Emit is a separate
Specs are not excluded — they are part of the typecheck gate.
